summary: This is the GitHub repository page for reachy_moveit_config_ros2, a MoveIt2 configuration package for the Reachy robot, published by the pollen-robotics organization under an Apache-2.0 license. The README explains installing ROS2 Foxy on Ubuntu 20.04, MoveIt2, and the reachy_description_ros2 package, then building with colcon. It describes launching the demo file, where users pick a planning group (right arm, left arm or head), move a blue ball at the end effector to a goal pose, and click Plan and Execute to run a trajectory with obstacle avoidance using fake trajectory controllers. The repository shows 1 star, 0 forks, 0 issues and 2 commits, and is 93.1% Python and 6.9% CMake.
one_line: A MoveIt2 configuration package for the Reachy robot on ROS 2 Foxy, with a demo launch for planning arm and head trajectories.
key_facts: reachy_moveit_config_ros2 is a MoveIt2 configuration package for Reachy, published by the pollen-robotics organization on GitHub.
The repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.
The README's integration of Reachy into MoveIt2 is described as being for ROS 2.
Installation requires ROS2 Foxy installed on top of Ubuntu 20.04.
The install steps clone reachy_moveit_config_ros2 and reachy_description_ros2 into ~/ros2_ws/src.
The workspace is built with colcon build --symlink-install from ~/ros2_ws.
The demo is started with the command ros2 launch reachy_moveit_config_ros2 demo.launch.py.
In the demo, the user picks a group in the Query Planning Group field of the Motion Planning panel: right arm, left arm or head.
The user moves the blue ball at the tip of the end effector to a goal pose, then clicks Plan and Execute.
The planned trajectory includes obstacle avoidance and is run with fake trajectory controllers.
The repository had 1 star, 0 forks, 0 open issues and 0 open pull requests at the time of capture.
The repository has 2 commits on the main branch and no published releases or packages.
The repository's languages are Python at 93.1% and CMake at 6.9%.
